comments.mergedPostDetails:
Lately the sound coming from players using regular voice chat has been of rather poor quality: it sounds choppy, it periodically cuts out, fills with unpleasant grinding noise, crackles, etc. I think first cases of decline of a voice chat quality for happened on October 9 and then it was fine for awhile but for the last few days it started happening more and more frequently. Here's a video from today when the voice sound worsened overtime - to the point of completely dissapearing: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NQwuE2o9F24CbSn8ZFcNHSInUgphOn1G/view?usp=sharing (2.5 min long video; file size is too big)

Yesterday the sound quelity rapidly declined closer to the evening, though it was fine for hour earlier, today it was bad right away, though seemengly it didn't equally affect the sound coming from all players in the instance: some may sound normal, some incredibly choppy. 

However, after said rapid decline on yesterday's evening I dicided to move from a Japanese to European instance and the sound of people's voices were still crackling, other people in that instance were also complaining afterwards. So, the issue remained present in both previous and current (2026.4.1) new patch.

The region is Russia which always has a lot of connection problems but while we're used to broken audio and video players choppy and juttery sound from a regular voice chat is something new. And if some video players may be fixed via VPN-like services, the quality of a sound from voice chat doesn't seem to be affected by it, doesn't matter which server, tunnel, app is used or if you even use anything at all. So, I'm not entirely sure if it's an issue of the Russian region, something from VRChat's side or both and I don't know if people from other places experienced it too recently.

details:
What happens:

After launching, joining worlds works fine at first. After a later world join, every player's voice becomes choppy/chopped up for me, and other players report that I sound choppy too. It stays broken in every world afterward, including worlds that worked earlier in the session, until I fully restart VRChat.

Steps to reproduce (from attached log):

1. Launch VRChat → Home

2. Join World A (Midnight Rooftop): voice fine

3. Join World B (The Black Cat): voice fine

4. Join World C (The Mafia Bar): voice choppy

5. Rejoin World A: still choppy

6. Restart VRChat → fixed

Observations:

- Debug menu shows 0 Loss by CRC Check, 0 Loss by Challenge, round trip variance ~5, Suffering 0. The network is clean.

- In the Players debug panel, Intrvl Q turns red for almost every player once the problem starts (mostly green/yellow before).

- In the log, the join where it broke shows "LocalPlayerObject is null, retrying in 2 seconds" (22:18:46). Right after that, departing players start being "Moved to recovery list". This doesn't happen in the earlier worlds, and on leaving World C every player was moved to the recovery list.

- Not hardware-related: other apps sound fine, and a VRChat restart fixes it every time.
title: [2026.4.1p2-1938] Voice becomes choppy (incoming + outgoing) after a later world join, persists until restart. No packet loss
